title: Taraji Learning Hub
description: A high-performance web platform for a community-based non-profit organization focused on mental health support and advocacy. The application features a semantic, keyboard-navigable structure to achieve a perfect 100/100 accessibility rating.

title: Interactive Tic-Tac-Toe Game
description: A responsive, fully interactive strategy game deployed on Render to master rigorous component architecture and application state. The project implements structured type interfaces to guarantee bulletproof data validation across runtime states

title: Disney+ Clone Frontend Dashboard
description: Engineered a responsive, media-centric user interface clone of Disney+ deployed on Netlify. Built strictly with Vanilla HTML5, Native CSS3, and JavaScript, the project bypasses frameworks to demonstrate deep mastery of core web standards.
